description: Send us a free or open data source we do not list yet. It goes into a private queue and is checked like every listing (free access, terms, policy); nothing is published automatically and the URL is not visited by this server. Give the provider's own https page (no shorteners, IP addresses, paste or leak sites, malware hosts or dark-web links), its name, a domain from the list, and why it is useful in at most 280 characters. Optional handle (letters, digits, _ or -, at most 40) may be credited as plain text if the source is listed. Do not include personal information. Limit: 5 an hour per caller.

domain.description: Which kind of data it is

handle.description: Optional credit handle: letters, digits, _ or -

name.description: Name of the source or provider

reason.description: Why it is useful, plain text, at most 280 characters

url.description: The provider's own https page for the data, for example its API docs

name: suggest_source
title: Suggest a data source
